publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.16 lets an existing hosted installation switch outbound email on or off in place. MAIL_PROVIDER is public and defaults to none when omitted. Keep the existing deployment checkout, account, environment, ownership receipt and private settings. Put MAIL_FROM and SENDGRID_API_KEY in an owned mode-0600 deploy.env file outside Git, then enable email with rer deploy --set-secret MAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid --set-secret MAIL_FROM --set-secret SENDGRID_API_KEY --env-file deploy.env. Add --environment NAME for a named environment. Switch SendGrid off with rer deploy --unset-secret MAIL_PROVIDER,MAIL_FROM,SENDGRID_API_KEY, without the enabling env-file or sending inputs in the shell. Remove obsolete selector, sender and key entries from .rer/deploy/<environment>.secrets.env when retiring email; preserve owner and installation keys. For another provider, also unset its declared sending inputs. Plain deploys preserve the selected provider. Guarded rer signin remains available while email links, invitations and email alerts are unavailable with mail off; local dev and demo mail are unchanged. Verify real sign-in and recipient delivery after enabling mail. Local deployment diagnostics use the declared none default. Hosted checks route through the public Cloudflare edge, including checks of another Worker in the monitor's own account. Failed status assertions name the HTTP status and any numeric Cloudflare Error 1xxx label; existing redacted failure snapshots retain the first 16 KiB of body when available, with the existing 64 KiB response-body limit. The deployment guide names account-scoped Workers Scripts: Edit and D1: Edit token permissions and says to name copies through --environment. Main's exact @runeditrun/rer 0.2.121 pin is retained, replacing 0.2.119 from 0.5.15. No database migration or new required setting is added: 91 SQL migration files before and after, with none added, changed or removed. Monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained on upgrade. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup. Local CLI export requires the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE described in the backup guide; keep it private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, stop dev or preview and deploy as usual. A legacy SendGrid installation with a saved key but no selector must explicitly select SendGrid with MAIL_PROVIDER=sendgrid rer deploy --environment NAME from its retained checkout and private inputs. Keep the deployment receipt and keys; do not rotate them for this upgrade. Earlier known issues and upgrade cautions remain, including old heartbeat output, UptimeRobot monitor CSV import, erased-people restore, empty company decision feeds, the 64 KiB response-body bound and unestablished large-scale archive operation. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0 through 0.5.13; it is not a new 0.5.16 capture.
